# Business Context (for LLM understanding)

## About מישל המלכה
A kitesurfing instructor offering lessons and courses, combining the thrill of wind and waves with professional coaching. The brand revolves around the exciting and adventurous world of kitesurfing, targeting water sports enthusiasts who want to learn this dynamic sport. The atmosphere is energetic, outdoor, and ocean-inspired, with a strong emphasis on professional guidance and skill development.

## Services/Products
- הדרכת קייטסרפינג
- קורסי קייטסרפינג

## Target Audience
- צעירים חובבי הרפתקאות
- משפחות חובבות ספורט ימי
- צוותים עסקיים

## Industry
ספורט ימי / הדרכה
